# Lane ENDTRACE: an anonymous session's end hidden behind detachTap's
# embedded net.Conn (as nf1.AnswerConn's, lane PIPERESET): tlsend's Reset
# was psConn's clean Close, its CloseWrite only the close_notify.
tap-reset-closes | direct_nf1.go | func (t *detachTap) Reset() error      { return pathStream{Conn: t.Conn}.Reset() } | func (t *detachTap) Reset() error      { return t.Conn.Close() } | TestSessionWrappersPassTheEndOn
tap-closewrite-hidden | direct_nf1.go | func (t *detachTap) CloseWrite() error { return pathStream{Conn: t.Conn}.CloseWrite() } | func (t *detachTap) CloseWrite() error { return nil } | TestSessionWrappersPassTheEndOn
# Lane ENDTRACE: a relayed nf1 session's receipt hidden behind peekConn:
# tlsend's CloseWriteSyncReceived fell back to CloseWriteSync, so a join's
# hold ended at the far end's ENDACK (link spec/HopHold.tla hold-until-ack).
peek-receipt-hidden | direct.go | 	if s, ok := c.Conn.(interface{ CloseWriteSyncReceived(func()) error }); ok { | 	if s, ok := c.Conn.(interface{ CloseWriteSyncReceived(func()) error }); false && ok { | TestSessionWrappersPassTheEndOn
